# Sander Breivik

> Personal website of Sander Breivik, a full-stack developer based in Øygarden, outside Bergen, Norway. Holds a BSc in Informatics from NTNU and has worked at ACOS AS since 2019.

Pages are available as Markdown by requesting them with the `Accept: text/markdown` header. Content may be used for search and AI input, but not for AI training (see robots.txt).

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.sanderbreivik.no/): Introduction and links to profiles
- [CV (English)](https://www.sanderbreivik.no/CV-en): Experience, education and skills
- [CV (Norwegian)](https://www.sanderbreivik.no/CV-no): Same CV in Norwegian
